note: Status of every water system in Endur'O's mWater group (piped_systems.csv). A piped system joins the managed portfolio only when its rehabilitation works are complete AND its post-rehabilitation water-quality tests are done (Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026). tools/rebuild_piped_wq.py applies it: a system whose works_complete date is set and which has a result dated after it is managed, and only those post-rehabilitation results count; a result dated on or before works completion is baseline and never counts. The build fails if the extract holds a system id that is not listed here. status: managed / in_process / not_managed. confirmed: false marks a status inferred here that Endur'O should confirm.
source: Endur'O water systems from mWater (group c305b9b8, extract piped_systems.csv, pulled 2026-09-25); the four Moramanga systems identified from forms 3ef4385a and a34cb66b; status and join rule per Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026.
